answer: A payout is split so that 30% arrives at settlement and the rest over 19 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The pigment schedule is applied in garden and canyon publishes each instalment. Someone therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2775 identities would post 500 proofs and burn roughly 2 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
